summary: Iteration 2: full backend + frontend verification of new features (refund tracking, edit-expense with split-scaling, groceries CRUD + shopping intelligence + recipe cook, disabled future-month period filter, AI live data queries). Backend: 10/10 new pytest tests pass (test_iteration2.py) plus original 23/23 still green. Frontend UI verified end-to-end on Money, Groceries, Nutrition and AI Assistant. AI chat is actually working (Gemini key has budget) and returned real cash-spent figure (€106.89) from live DB. Container date is 2026-09-28 and the frontend correctly disables October & November 2026 period buttons via disabled attribute + cursor-not-allowed styling; September 2026 is selectable.

issues: Newly-added item shows extra numeric '0' after the item name (e.g. 'UITest_1790595083 0') — looks like the quantity is being rendered twice (once in name area, once in the +/- stepper). Cosmetic only.

action_items: Investigate the stray '0' rendered next to newly-created grocery item names in the inventory list (minor cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1450 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (finance, groceries/shopping, nutrition, ai) for maintainability.

update_transaction: when the caller passes only `personal_amount` without `amount`, the code only updates personal/reimbursable and does NOT rewrite the splits, so per-person shares on the txn document become stale relative to the new personal amount. UI currently always sends both, but the endpoint contract is inconsistent.
shopping_payload.recommendation is built by string concatenation with € formatting — fine for now, but any i18n later will need refactor.
delete_transaction still does not roll back inventory items created via add_to_inventory (carry-over from iter1).
AI dispatch_tool builds fake user dicts like {'_id':'ai'} to satisfy Depends(get_current_user)-typed helpers — works but fragile; better to refactor internal helpers to be dependency-free.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create/delete TEST2_-prefixed data cleanly. UI test left one grocery item 'UITest_<ts>' and one AI-created cook meal record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (23 tests, foundation) and /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (10 tests, new features). Run all with `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v`. AI (Gemini via Emergent LLM key) is LIVE and answering with real DB numbers — do not assume budget exhausted. Container real date is 2026-09-28 so Sept 2026 is enabled and Oct/Nov 2026 must remain disabled in Money filter.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Only cosmetic finding is the duplicated quantity '0' shown next to newly added grocery item names (likely a rendering that concatenates name + quantity when a quantity field is missing/zero for the row header).
